steps: A main-page button opens a same-origin blank popup using window.open('', '_blank').
The main page sets popup.opener = null, matching reports.jsx openPrintableWindow.
The main page adds a click listener to a popup button; its closure reads both windows' navigator.userActivation.isActive.
Wait 6000 milliseconds to expire the transient activation from opening the popup.
Click the popup button using Playwright's data-testid locator.
codeImplication: USBReceipt.connect executes in the main window and explicitly rejects inactive main-window user activation with USB_GESTURE. A later click in this popup cannot satisfy that guard.
fixUnderReview: External PrintStatus receives its host window, offers print-usb-return instead of print-usb-connect, and returns to the main window while preserving the prepared job. The main window retains the Conectar e imprimir action.
scope: This independent reproduction exercises real Chrome user activation, not the BALAM bundle or USB transfers. The H-184 integration harness verifies the final popup recovery path separately.
usbMock: Not used; no WebUSB device request or transfer was made.
